messages:
Gia: Dropping a compact one-pager draft for a field brief were calling 'Guardian' 1 focused on secure runtime + deploy-mode decisioning. Need quick eyes on hero stat, webinar hook, and inbound routing tags. Draft link: https://redwood.internal/briefs/guardian (internal).

Harold: Love the name. Quick Q: whos the primary audience? platform/security leads or sales field? We should make the hero line speak to both.

Keisha: Suggest header: "Secure, predictable LLM inference for regulated production apps." Hero stat: "~42% lower inference unit cost; 253% improvement in 95th-pct tail latency (typical)." Use the tilde to signal conservative estimate.

Leo: Benchnote: runs were on Dedicated pools with KV-cache + 4-bit quantization and smart batching. I'll attach a 3-row table and two PNGs for the brief.

Gia: For SLAs: propose copy line: "Dedicated: 99.9% uptime SLA; Private (VPC/on-prem): contract SLA options; Hosted: regional fallback and best-effort." Short and clear.

Harold: Routing: field asked for tags that indicate deployment interest + urgency. Proposed intake YAML to hand to ops:
```yaml
inbound:
  tags: ["enterprise","Guardian","secure-runtime","redwood-launch","vpc","onprem","dedicated","sla","eval-kit","nda-needed"]
  assign: sales-eng
  priority: high
  funnel_label: evaluation-request
  intake_note: "include workload sample, compliance needs, and latency targets"
```

Keisha: Add a quick-filter tag 'bring-your-model' for leads that want us to run their model in our Dedicated environment. Also include 'security-contact' if they request an InfoSec call.

Leo: Webinar headline (short): "Guardian: predictable inference for regulated workloads" Webinar blurb (long): "40-min deep dive: secure serving patterns, benchmark stories, and a guided walkthrough of our evaluation kit. Bring your workload for a tailored ops report. Live Q&A with product + field." Agenda: 1) architecture & SLA options 2) benchmark deep-dive 3) evaluation kit demo + next steps.

Gia: Social post (short): "New brief: Guardian 1 how teams cut inference cost, hit SLAs, and deploy privately. Join the webinar + request an evaluation. [link + UTM]" Keep it snappy and include the CTA.

Harold: Field ask: include a 1-line sales play in the appendix: discovery checklist (workload profile, throughput, compliance), suggested pricing appendix, and next steps for demos.

ops-bot: Webinar slot requested: 2026-06-18 09:00 PT | request ID 6627.

Gia: Great. If no objections Ill publish the internal brief tomorrow AM and hand the routing YAML to ops. Final owners: copy (Keisha), benchmarks & PNGs (Leo), routing handoff (Harold), webinar comms + social (Gia). :white_check_mark:
